relationships.subject: Botulinum neurotoxin type A
relationships.evidence_quote: Both BoNT/A and the isolated catalytic light chain LC/A showed limited effects in heterologous expression systems and the neuronal cell line ND7/23.

key_findings: BoNT/A and its light chain LC/A had limited effects on Nav1.7, Nav1.3 and ND7/23 currents.
Spontaneous activity in iPSC sensory neurons, including from an Nav1.7 p.Q875E erythromelalgia patient, was unaltered by BoNT/A.
